answer: Assign each identity a distinct, overlapping slice of a shared lagoon to watch continuously: water level, a crystal marker's glint, a plume of sediment after rain. Pay only for timely reports whose overlapping edges agree with neighbours watching adjacent slices. A sybil farm cannot copy one report across shells, because each slice differs and its edges would mismatch, nor fake reports in bursts, because gaps break continuity. Scaling forces running a real, separate observation stream for every identity.
